surfaces.name: openapi
surfaces.description: The auth server's HTTP API as a default deployment serves it: every feature switch at its default. The stable surface of ADR-018 §5.

surfaces.name: openapi-maximal
surfaces.description: The same API with every switch that registers a route turned on, as the docs site publishes it. Checked for drift and for stability tags, never for breaks.

surfaces.name: admin-permissions
surfaces.description: The admin permission catalog: every permission id, retired ones included, with its class (ADR-019 Decision 7, #507). Custom roles store the ids, so a removed permission or a changed class is a break; a new or retired permission is not.

surfaces.name: event-envelope
surfaces.description: The envelope every QAuth event carries, of any type (ADR-018 §5, #456). Compared as both: QAuth emits it, and the events it stored under an earlier release must still match it.

surfaces.name: event-admin-change-applied-v1

surfaces.name: interaction-api-v1
surfaces.description: The Interaction API v1-rc.0 contract: the OpenAPI 3.1 document of /interaction/v1-rc.0, with every step's schema (ADR-019 Decision 6, ADR-018 §5, #590). The auth server serves the same document at /interaction/v1-rc.0/openapi.json.
